ppbw.float: PPB values must fit in a finite 32-bit float.
cli.opt.workspace.ppbconfig: Existing PPB tuning TXT to edit in the collider workspace.
cli.opt.workspace.ppbout: New path for edited PPB tuning TXT.
page.startupDataError: The viewer could not read its model data. Try another file and check the Morphbench log.
page.noRenderableGeometry: This NIF has no surface geometry. Its available skeleton and collision data remain accessible.
page.edPpbScope: PPB source geometry. Choose its NIF target explicitly; the game's result depends on PPB runtime rules.
page.edPpbLink: Link these records for visual editing
page.edPpbLinkHelp: Linking copies the PPB source geometry into the selected capsule. Moving or resizing this capsule then edits PPB values, and numeric PPB edits update the preview. Enable is separate. Replacing the source or skeleton, resetting or changing the capsule list ends the link.
page.edPpbLinked: PPB source editing: %(record)s ↔ %(bone)s · %(index)s. Changes to this capsule also update the tuning text.
page.edPpbTo: Copy PPB geometry to selected capsule
page.edPpbFrom: Copy selected capsule to PPB values
page.edPpbEmpty: Open a PPB tuning file. Existing comments, unknown commands and formatting are preserved.
ppbw.transfer: This PPB record has no complete supported geometry, or the selected capsule is unavailable.
ppbw.sourceOnly: PPB source values only; runtime geometry is unresolved.
ppbw.runtime: PPB_skeletons.txt sculpt/npcCap rules, actor sex, beast-head gates, existing children and runtime shape/scale stages can change or suppress these values.
ppbw.duplicates: Repeated PPB keys use the last successfully parsed assignment.
ppbw.malformed: A PPB capsule assignment is outside the supported numeric syntax; geometry transfer is withheld.
ppbw.unsupported: This PPB capsule key is outside the reviewed slot/child table and is preserved as text.
ppbw.incomplete: Missing capsule fields are not inferred from runtime defaults.
ppbw.nonpositive: Capsule radius must be positive for geometry transfer.
ppbw.bom: The UTF-8 BOM is preserved; upstream PPB does not strip it from the first command.
ppbw.hand: Hand C1 addresses list child 0; the unsuffixed Hand block addresses a single capsule.
ppbw.mirror: capMirrorL mirrors supported right-side writes by negating body-local X; this source editor does not simulate those writes.
ppbw.autofit: capAutoFit can own endpoints at runtime; this source editor does not simulate auto-fit.
page.edStale: These capsule edits belong to a different skeleton.
workspace.stale: The model has changed. Reopen the model before exporting these edits.
workspace.origin: Only same-origin JSON requests are accepted.
workspace.large: The workspace request is too large.
page.edFrame: Endpoints use the Havok body's local frame, in game units.
page.edDrag: Shift + left-drag a capsule to select and move it in the camera plane. Alt + click selects. Drag the selected capsule's centre handle to move it without Shift.
page.edMove: Drag to move this capsule in the camera plane
page.edNominal: Configured limits only. No motion or contact simulation.
page.edNoConfig: Open an FSMP XML or CBPC TXT to inspect and edit its numeric parameters.
page.edRawOnly: Raw parameters; spatial range is unavailable for this configuration.
page.edServer: Importing XML/TXT requires the local server. A saved workspace JSON can also be opened offline.
page.edNoCapsules: Open a model with a skeleton to edit collision capsules.
page.edNoServerExport: Use the local server to download NIF, or replay the edit recipe with mb.py workspace.
